name: 腾讯元器
desc: Tencent's platform for building and publishing agents.
desc_zh: 腾讯搭建并分发智能体的平台。
solves: An agent worth handing to colleagues or customers, built by someone who does not write code. Yuanqi assembles it by dragging and publishes it.
solves_zh: 想做个智能体分发给同事或客户，但你不写代码。元器拖拽就能搭好，再发布出去。
best_for: You want an agent other people can open and use directly, without installing anything.
best_for_zh: 你要做一个别人打开就能直接用的智能体，并分发给他们。
notes: 官网已确认，标题「腾讯元器 - AI 智能体创建与分发平台」，是一个智能体广场式的搭建与分发平台。
